name: claudex
description: Codex and Claude Code together. Local threads, plans, approvals, and diffs in VS Code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Agent execution and workspace documents require workspace trust.

commands.title: Claudex: Sign In to an Agent

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Claudex
walkthroughs.description: Run Claude Code and Codex side by side in VS Code, with your own accounts.

steps.title: Open Claudex
steps.description:
Your chat and threads live in the side bar.
[Open Claudex](command:agentWorkspace.open)

steps.title: Install Claude Code or Codex
steps.description:
Claudex runs the CLIs on this machine. Install at least one, then check.
[Check my agents](command:agentWorkspace.checkAgents)

steps.title: Sign in
steps.description:
Sign in once in the CLI's own terminal. Claudex never sees your credentials.
[Sign in to Claude Code](command:agentWorkspace.signIn?%5B%22claude%22%5D)
[Sign in to Codex](command:agentWorkspace.signIn?%5B%22codex%22%5D)

steps.title: Start your first thread
steps.description:
Pick an agent, write a message and press Enter.
[Start a thread](command:agentWorkspace.new)

steps.title: Ask, Plan and Auto
steps.description: Press ⇧Tab in the message box to choose how much the agent may do.

steps.title: Use both agents together
steps.description: @mention an agent, attach files with #, and hand a thread to the other agent.

agentWorkspace.codexPath.description: Codex executable name or absolute path.

agentWorkspace.claudePath.description: Claude Code executable name or absolute path.

agentWorkspace.profiles.markdownDescription: Extra accounts for Claude Code or Codex. Each one runs the installed CLI with its own home folder (`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` or `CODEX_HOME`), so its settings, skills, plugins, MCP servers, sign-in and history are separate. `claude` and `codex` are always available when installed. Use the agent menu's **Add profile** to fill this in.

id.markdownDescription: Fixed handle for `@mentions`, such as `claude-work`. Changing it disconnects threads that used the old one.

name.description: Shown in the agent menu. Rename it freely.

configDir.markdownDescription: This account's home folder, such as `~/.claude-work`. Becomes `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` or `CODEX_HOME`. Leave unset for the CLI's default.

executable.description: An executable to run instead of the installed CLI. Shell aliases aren't executables.

agentWorkspace.claud2Path.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `agentWorkspace.profiles`. Still read for the old Claude 2 profile.
agentWorkspace.claud2Path.description: Second Claude Code executable or wrapper path. Shell aliases and command arguments are not executable paths.

agentWorkspace.claud2ConfigDir.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `agentWorkspace.profiles`. Still read for the old Claude 2 profile.
agentWorkspace.claud2ConfigDir.description: Used when no second Claude executable is found: runs Claude Code with this folder as CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, the same as an alias like claude2='CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.claude-account2 claude'.

agentWorkspace.guidedPlanning.description: Ask agents for clear, evidence-based plans, useful diagrams, and acceptance tests.

agentWorkspace.richExplanations.description: In Ask mode, ask agents to add a sandboxed visual when a picture explains something better than prose.

enumDescriptions: Send the goal and as much recent history as fits in about 10k tokens.
Send the goal and as much history as fits in about 75k tokens.
Send nothing: switching agent moves only your draft, as before.
agentWorkspace.crossAgentContext.markdownDescription: When you continue a thread in another agent, how much of its history goes with your next message, as a chip you can open or remove. Going back to an agent sends only what's new since. Hidden reasoning and approvals never transfer.

enumDescriptions: Cursor's dark colors on any dark theme. Light and high contrast themes still follow the editor.
Follow the active editor theme everywhere.
